name: Extended Studies and Public Programs - Building N
provenance: Official UCSD Facilities room vectors and matching room inventory from the public classroom floor-plan embed. Local coordinates only; approximate metric scale. Full exterior walls are unavailable.

coordinateSystem.description: Local source-plan frame; approximate shared metric scale from listed room areas.
coordinateSystem.northNote: The raster and its north arrow were unavailable. No campus registration is asserted.

sources.title: UC San Diego Campus Map, building footprints and heights
Official public floor-plan vectors and room inventory
sources.revision: Not printed in public metadata; published floor-plan key 5624
sources.scale: Median of independent per-room area scales; same scale applied to every polygon.
notes: Room IDs, labels, areas and polygon coordinates are directly published together in the official embedded viewer HTML. The image tiles require login and were not obtained.
Coordinates are normalized separately by image width and height; source geometry is preserved under one shared uniform conversion per building.
The shared metric scale is estimated from listed room areas. Cross-room area agreement checks consistency, not independent surveying accuracy.
No campus rotation or absolute north direction is established. This supplement uses a local frame without geo.
Floor patches cover the sourced rooms only. Corridors, exterior walls and door locations are not reconstructed; floor height remains illustrative.
